Regarding the impact of the documentary on factory farming: The release of this documentary is likely to have a significant polarizing effect on public opinion. For the target audience of animal welfare advocates and environmentally conscious consumers, it will likely reinforce existing beliefs, leading to a measurable decrease in demand for factory-farmed products and a surge in interest toward vegan and cruelty-free alternatives. This could drive short-term sales shifts for plant-based brands and increase pressure on food corporations to adopt more transparent or humane sourcing practices. However, among consumers who are less engaged with these issues or who prioritize cost and convenience, the impact may be minimal or temporary, as dietary habits are deeply ingrained. Overall, the documentary serves as a catalyst for broader cultural conversation, potentially accelerating the mainstream acceptance of alternative proteins and influencing policy debates around agricultural regulations.
